scope: Research/specification direction; independent Intents verifier/accounting/escrow review. Other panel domains are not independently re-audited in this vote.
caveats: The opening ZKIRv3 and proof-carrying-language statements are controlling product requirements, not findings that Moriarty already demonstrates these capabilities.

The escrow precedent establishes persisted maker funding, constrained fills and optional partial quantities; it does not implement generalized accumulation of recipient signatures, documents and proofs.

Escrow cleanup counts tracked maker balances and callbacks. Its maker/taker recovery asymmetry means cleanup is not proof that every participant received payment. Preserve that limitation in the eventual specification rationale.
Nonce mutation before operation dispatch is still inside the verifier receipt boundary. Successful verifier execution followed by a failed downstream receipt does not restore the nonce.
Signature/accounting checks, simulation results, document commitments and a panel endorsement each establish narrower claims than arbitrary-program correctness or external finality.

This vote does not validate unseen MPLR-001..018 record bodies, an implementation package, deployed role holders, build flags or compiler/ledger correspondence. It endorses their proposed coverage and the direction stated in this exact candidate.
evidence_that_would_change_vote: A subsequent specification substitutes a fixed template set or project admission registry for the permissionless all-Midnight-DeFi language.
A continuation/evidence design can change signed terms, duplicate a settlement right, erase an unresolved payout duty or bypass stage-specific authorization.
Pinned implementation evidence contradicts the claimed verifier or escrow boundaries, particularly recovery accounting or condition validation.
The final implementation asserts unconditional documentary truth, remote delivery, proof soundness or ZKIRv3 correspondence without evidence matching that exact property.
